title: Validate GetSeatMap is rejected (or returns an explicit not-supported response) when called for an offer whose isSeatMapRequired flag was false at FareConfirm/AddPassenger time.
request_summary: Search JED-RUH 2026-09-20 (1 ADT/1 CHD/1 INF) -> FareConfirm offers[0] -> AddPassenger -> GetSeatMap using AddPassenger's offerId/responseId
response_summary: Search: 200, 10 offers, isSeatMapRequired=false on every offer. FareConfirm: 200, isSeatMapRequired=false, haveBundles=true, canBeHeld=false. AddPassenger: 200. GetSeatMap: HTTP 500 {Status:500,ErrorCode:'ServerError',ErrorMessage:'Unknown error occured. Please keep the transaction id as a reference.',Context:[]}
expected: Rejected or an explicit not-supported envelope returned (candidate: the same {ErrorCode:'OperationNotSupported'} shape confirmed live for GetOfferBundles on a haveBundles=false offer), rather than HTTP 200 with malformed/empty seatMapDetails.
actual: Request was rejected (not a 200) -- satisfies the test case's core assertion. However the rejection is an unhandled HTTP 500 'ServerError' with a generic message, not a structured business-rule rejection like GetOfferBundles' confirmed 409 OperationNotSupported pattern.
evidence: Raw response body: {"Status":500,"TransactionId":"2c3dd063-d01c-4de1-9bc9-fcae0be322db","ErrorCode":"ServerError","ErrorMessage":"Unknown error occured. Please keep the transaction id as a reference.","Context":[]}

field_name: HTTP status / ErrorCode on GetSeatMap for isSeatMapRequired=false offer
summary: GetSeatMap throws an unhandled HTTP 500 'ServerError' (generic, not business-rule-specific) when called against an offer whose isSeatMapRequired flag is false, instead of a graceful structured rejection.
expected_value: A 4xx business-rule rejection with a specific ErrorCode (e.g. 409 'OperationNotSupported', matching the confirmed live pattern for GetOfferBundles on a haveBundles=false offer, §2.4)
impact: Callers cannot distinguish this from an actual server fault/outage; monitoring/alerting on 500s will fire for what is actually an expected, capability-driven rejection, and no machine-readable signal exists to tell an integrating client 'this offer has no seat map' short of pre-checking isSeatMapRequired themselves.
evidence: Raw 500 response body captured above, TransactionId 2c3dd063-d01c-4de1-9bc9-fcae0be322db

summary: Live-sampled across 4 FlyAdeal/EGY route+date combinations (JED-RUH 2026-09-20, JED-RUH 2026-10-05, RUH-DMM 2026-09-20, RUH-JED 2026-09-20 -- JED-AMM returned 0 offers), every single offer returned isSeatMapRequired=false. This run found zero evidence of a FlyAdeal offer ever requiring/supporting a seat map under the EGY credentials selector, blocking every positive SeatMap test case for this supplier/selector pairing. Not conclusive proof of 'Not Supported' (other routes/fare classes/selectors were not sampled), but strong live evidence worth recording distinctly from a flat 'Unknown'.

title: Validate GetSeatMap rejects requests with each mandatory field individually omitted: supplier, credentialsSelector, ResponseId, selectedOfferId.
request_summary: 4 runs, each omitting one of supplier/credentialsSelector/ResponseId/selectedOfferId from the baseline GetSeatMap request.
response_summary: omit supplier: 400 {errorCode:'1001', context:[{name:'Supplier',value:'Select a valid Supplier'}]}. omit credentialsSelector: 400 {errorCode:'1001', context:[{name:'CredentialsSelector',value:'Select a valid CredentialsSelector'}]}. omit ResponseId: HTTP 500 {ErrorCode:'ServerError'} (generic, NOT a validation 400). omit selectedOfferId: 400 {errorCode:'1001', context:[{name:'SelectedOfferId',value:'The SelectedOfferId field is required.'}]}.
expected: All four runs rejected; no seatMapDetails returned in any run.
actual: All four rejected as expected. 3 of 4 (supplier, credentialsSelector, selectedOfferId) get a clean, graceful 400 validation error naming the missing field. The 4th (ResponseId) instead falls through to the same generic unhandled 500 seen elsewhere in this run -- an inconsistency in how mandatory fields are validated (see Findings).
evidence: omit-supplier TransactionId c5cc6999-9a75-40db-9c7e-542b01e2ad07; omit-credentialsSelector c3185b34-c612-4032-a095-d2e0c5a2e326; omit-ResponseId 36ec10b3-59a6-4093-9b0d-8b91faaee2bb; omit-selectedOfferId e25c081d-f43d-4278-b3c7-78ca4d8ad8bc

summary: Omitting the mandatory ResponseId field from a GetSeatMap request causes an unhandled HTTP 500 'ServerError', while omitting Supplier, CredentialsSelector, or SelectedOfferId each correctly returns a clean HTTP 400 validation error naming the missing field.
expected_value: HTTP 400 with errorCode '1001' and a context entry naming 'ResponseId' as required, matching the other three mandatory fields' behavior
impact: Inconsistent input validation: three of four mandatory fields fail gracefully with an actionable message, the fourth (ResponseId) surfaces as an opaque server fault -- confusing for API consumers and noisy for server-error monitoring/alerting.
evidence: TransactionId 36ec10b3-59a6-4093-9b0d-8b91faaee2bb -- {"Status":500,"ErrorCode":"ServerError","ErrorMessage":"Unknown error occured. Please keep the transaction id as a reference."}

summary: GetSeatMap's validation-error envelope shape is now confirmed live: {status, transactionId, errorCode:'1001', errorMessage:'Validation errors occurred. Please check your request.', context:[{name, value}], originalSupplierRequest, originalSupplierResponse} -- with all-lowercase leading field names. This differs in casing from the same endpoint's business/server-error envelope (TC-SEATMAP-NEG-01/02/03), which uses PascalCase leading field names (Status, TransactionId, ErrorCode, ErrorMessage, Context) -- a genuine, evidenced casing inconsistency between two error paths on the same endpoint, not a transcription artifact.

GetSeatMap's three universal security checks are now confirmed live: invalid x-api-key and invalid Client-Id both return HTTP 401 {ErrorCode:'AuthenticationError', 'Invalid authorization header'}; a cross-tenant credentialsSelector switch (EGY-established chain re-called with credentialsSelector=UAE) returns HTTP 400 {ErrorCode:'ValidationError', 'The credentials for the selected supplier do not exist or are not active. Please verify the credentialsSelector value.'} -- confirming FlyAdeal has no active UAE credentials on this host, consistent with the Harness README's 2026-08-05 finding on a different (staging) host.
evidence: See TC-SEATMAP-SEC-01 hop evidence, TransactionIds 8f533090-2ee1-47d4-8d97-09c61b904a07 / dfb84afe-c370-4042-a101-1cf996bfbc7e / 9b65e2a3-ac0f-4248-b09e-7cb2e3afe018
